errors.evidence: The y-axis major tick marks are at intervals of 2% (82, 84, 86, 88, 90), not 1% as stated in the description.
The description does not mention the circular markers for each data point on the lines, which was requested by the prompt's requirement to describe 'marker shape'.
For the blue line (Precision), the value at mBERT-0 is approximately 81.2%, not 82% as stated.
The description states the Precision (blue line) at mBERT-30 is 84.5% and at mBERT-50 is 87%. The chart shows these values are approximately 84.1% and 86.4% respectively.
For the red line (Recall), the value at mBERT-0 is approximately 83.4%, not 83.8%.
The description states the Recall (red line) at mBERT-30 is 87%, but the chart shows the value is approximately 86.6%.
The description states the F1 Score (green line) at mBERT-50 is 87.5%, but the chart shows the value is approximately 87.0%.
